absolute-zero:
TC124-AZ-01 DIRECTOR COMPLETION (NEW locally except expressly inherited rules). The base price is 13 RP on the actual selected access route. The endpoint is selected at successful establishment: the caster's next original regular START strictly after establishment, or establishment+6 seconds when established outside initiative; ordinary Ready is still paid at preparation and the endpoint starts at release/establishment, not preparation. A source marker already underway is not made future. The cold packet has the actual original caster's ordinary damage-root provenance. Resolve complete defenses, sharing, zero/death/Wounds and damage-concentration consequences before attempting suspension. A transferred branch cannot acquire the rider. A living Dying/Stable creature can be suspended if it survives the packet and the source/target hard guard permits; immunity to cold is not immunity to suspension.
While operative, direct HP expenditure through a voluntary activation is not payable; involuntary direct HP losses, healing, temp HP and physical condition admissions to the body are prevented as bodily outputs. Nonbodily source endings, deadlines, private ownership/spent histories and actual explicitly world-timed lethal tracks are not prevented. True death from an independently specified world-timed cause ends this suspension and its concentration; it is not stored for later. This does not invent such a lethal track.
Use the same body-emitted-output boundary as selected Chrono Lock: no body aura output, new speech, personal command or further personal cast requirement while held. Independent established external fields keep their own controllers, deadlines and exact concentration requirements. Suspension does not itself impose ordinary Incapacitated or erase consciousness flags belonging to another cause. Real mandatory form endings and concentration/source termination still occur as source transitions; they do not duplicate the old body or equipment. The held pose remains, with legal support/placement reconciled on release under the actual body source, without remote eviction.
Stable recovery is not an expended periodic damage tick: preserve its actual already-rolled absolute deadline. If due while this suspension blocks its 1HP, retain an overdue pending-state receipt and do not reroll the d4, restart time or heal through protection. When the block actually ends, resolve that same due state recovery once if legal under the accepted regular-start/changed-blocker ordering; any independent HP-gain blocker still applies. No omitted death save or missed periodic damage is replayed. Actual END events resolve before END-bound cleanup; this source's START-bound ending resolves before the caster's mandatory START processing. Round identity and source-owned recharge/caps are not rewritten. Externally supplied temporal-remove/immune permissions must be real; none is created merely by writing that a callback exists.

contingency:
TC124-CT-01 DIRECTOR COMPLETION. The 24-hour frame,60-second loading interval, rank0..5 ordinary payload whitelist by declared capability (not an invented spell), bound-body sensors, displaced concentration at load, unloaded concentration storage, automatic bound-origin release and finite dispatch policy above are all expressly selected NEW local authoring. At frame commitment freeze bound identity and the complete event/deadline/predicate declaration. At payload commitment freeze actual modes, whole material/target/body/state plan, genuine current eligibility, any expressly load-time costs/snapshots, and all optional choices. This includes the full Grave Gift target/HP-cost record. Reserve the frame's single load attempt atomically with the legal payload commitment; an invalid not-yet-committed declaration does not debit or fabricate eligibility. A payload counter or real paid failure ends that frame. The original load deadline is formation+60 and frame expiry formation+86400; equality expires before load/release. A dispatch epoch snapshots the finite set of already-armed frame IDs BEFORE the complete originating external event begins. A frame created/loaded in that event cannot join that epoch. Capture actual qualifying event records after the event completes, including all inherent damage/sharing/life/death and native source consequences. Original event and frame IDs key durable claims. Consume each qualifying frame/payload before its attempt. Revalidate owner alive, exact same-plane relation, target and current suppression before releasing. Cap is original-owner/numbered-round; outside initiative the next release is no earlier than six actual seconds after the last attempted release, and transitions conserve the last original receipt instead of minting another slot. A permitted failed release attempt consumes the cap and payload; an observation missed while suppressed never creates a deferred claim. Expiry wins equality; a deadline while suppressed/inactive consumes its only deadline chance and ends the frame. Later ending/suppression of already-created native children uses their own actual rules, not automatic reactivation of the spent frame.
For actual damage payloads create their first real source-owned root at the automatic RELEASE effect-creation checkpoint, after complete causing-event settlement and legal payload admission, before RNG/recipient application. Keep the original loadingCastId, original caster/dealer, selected class/rank/DC and full already-paid history; do not create a second cast ID/counter window. Fireball's recipient branches share its one original release cast/root ancestry; redirects retain provenance and do not become new casts or new frame-release opportunities. Direct recovery, temporary HP or source endings do not fabricate damage roots.
Further genuine events caused by these releases may visit only remaining frames in the same finite prearmed set. Stable creation order then immutable ID orders competing frames; one frame is visited once, and original-owner cap remains authoritative. Previously ended/replaced source records cannot be used again. No child outcome recursively rereads a frame's old spent event or copies a source-use. Suppression/class immunity cannot retroactively refund payments or undo completed damage. The positive reactive-release framework is authored here; production dispatch/persistence and arbitrary native payload adapters remain implementation work.
